text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a modern software development practice that helps teams work more efficiently. With CI, developers regularly add their code to a shared repository. Every time new code is added, automated builds start immediately. This means the software is always checked and updated without manual effort. As part of the process, running tests is essential. These tests check whether the new code works correctly and does not break existing features. One of the main benefits of CI is catching issues early, before they become serious problems. CI pipelines organize all these steps, from building to testing, making the development process faster and more reliable.
